chartPattern.explanation: The pattern shows a left shoulder around $94.66 (May 4), a head at $116.24 (June 1), and a right shoulder forming around $108.01 (June 2) and $102.13 (June 3). The neckline is drawn across the lows between these peaks, around $94.0.
chartPattern.signal: A confirmed Head and Shoulders pattern could signal a bearish reversal, indicating a potential downtrend following the prior rally.

fundamentals.name: Atlassian Corporation
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Atlassian Corporation provides a collaboration software that enables organizations to connect all teams through a system of work that unlocks productivity at scale worldwide. Its product portfolio includes Jira, a project management platform for planning, tracking, and managing work; Confluence, a connected workspace to create, organize, and share team knowledge, documents, and collaboration content; Loom, an asynchronous video communication tool to record and share videos; Jira Service Management, an intuitive service management solution for IT, HR, and other teams; and Rovo, an AI offering that assists teams with its Search, Chat and Agent capabilities. The company also offers Bitbucket, a git-based source code management platform for professional development teams; Compass, a developer portal that provides a unified view of engineering components; Jira Product Discovery, a tool to capture, prioritize, and roadmap product ideas; Jira Align, an enterprise agility solution that connects business and technology teams to align strategy with execution; Focus, a strategy hub for leadership teams; and Talent, a workforce planning app. In addition, it provides Trello, an AI-powered personal productivity tool; and Guard, an app for detecting and responding to security threats. The company has a strategic collaboration with Mattermost, Inc. for the development of Mattermost Docs, a sovereign, self-hosted successor to Confluence for defense, intelligence, and critical infrastructure organizations. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Sydney, Australia.

judgment.summary: Strong revenue growth and free cash flow are offset by high leverage and negative profit margins.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter beat estimates by 31.0%; next earnings date is 2026-07-30.
positives: Revenue growth 31.7% YoY, with analyst estimates for current Q and FY above 49%.
Free cash flow (TTM) of $1.58B indicates strong operational cash generation.
Forward P/E of 16.03 and PEG ratio of 0.78 suggest reasonable valuation relative to growth.
Gross margin of 84.8% is very high, indicating efficient core operations.
Last quarter's EPS beat of 31.0% shows strong execution.
negatives: Profit margin of -3.5% and Return on equity of -19.3% indicate unprofitability.
Debt/Equity ratio of 141.41 is very high, suggesting significant financial risk.
Current ratio of 0.70 and Quick ratio of 0.61 indicate potential short-term liquidity issues.
Operating margin of 9.4% is modest compared to gross margin, suggesting high operating expenses.

news.paragraph: Atlassian (TEAM) saw its stock rise 8.8% after reporting better-than-expected earnings and raising its outlook, while also announcing job cuts to fund AI investments. The company's last reported quarter showed an EPS beat of 31.0% against estimates, with analyst growth estimates remaining strong for the current quarter and fiscal year. Despite a high debt-to-equity ratio and negative profit margin, the company's substantial free cash flow and strong revenue growth suggest a positive trajectory.
